cat.title: Idea evaluation
cat.intro: You will rate a set of ideas, in random order, with no information about how they were generated. Rate each from 1 to 5 on three dimensions.

onb.tagline: Pull up a stool. Let's develop an idea together — you and a few AIs, at the same table.
onb.about_body: A study on how people and AI create ideas together. Instead of a dry questionnaire, you'll play: sit at a virtual bar table and develop an idea, round by round, alongside AI characters. We observe the process and the result of that joint creation.
onb.game_body: The night has a central theme. Each round, you and the AIs propose an idea about it. The ideas appear shuffled and unnamed — and you pick the best. The chosen one joins the table's line of ideas, and the next round builds from there. Four rounds. At the end, the Bar Owner weaves it all into a final idea.
onb.ai_personas_b: AI characters, each with its own voice and point of view. All take part in every round.
onb.ai_draw_b: Some details of the table — who sits and certain rules — are drawn automatically. This keeps the study fair and comparable across participants.
onb.ai_judge_b: A neutral AI that also picks the best idea each round — without knowing who proposed each one, or what you chose. Then we compare the picks.
onb.ai_owner_b: At the end of the night, it weaves the advanced ideas into a final, structured proposal.
onb.step1_b: A few questions before we start.
onb.step2_b: 4 rounds of ideas at the table.
onb.step3_b: How the experience felt to you.
onb.step5_b: A final page with everything — download and send it to us.
onb.data_body: We collect the ideas, your choices and the form answers — nothing that identifies you. Everything is anonymous and used only for research.
onb.data_fictitious: So, use a fictitious name as your name at the table. That's how we make sure you can't be identified.
onb.download_body: At the end, you'll see a button to download your data. Download the file and send it to us — that's how your participation reaches the research. Without sending it, the data stays only on your computer.
